title: Unlock perks with a command in Free Play
summary: In Free Play, /dungeontrain perks grant and revoke unlock or lock perks for any player: all of them, one perk, or a whole class, like /advancement grant. Perks unlocked in Free Play now carry over to your next Free Play run, and never count toward your real progress. P also opens the perks menu in a world opened to LAN.
